title: Doc comments in seqnum.rs still reference u32::MAX instead of Self::MAX
description: seqnum.rs lines 55, 72: The doc comments for OscoreSeqNum::increment and fetch_increment say 'Returns None if the sequence number is at u32::MAX' but the actual check is against Self::MAX which is (1 << 40) - 1. The comments are misleading and were not updated when the type was changed from u32 to u64 internally.
